title: Container parity depth: lifecycle workflows, network safety validation, inspect UX
acceptance_criteria: Container network create/update rejects overlapping prefixes against existing networks.
Container upsert/install rejects static attachment addresses outside configured network prefixes.
Container upsert/install rejects IPv4 network or broadcast addresses for static assignments.
Container image lifecycle UI supports direct row-level actions from configured/runtime image lists.
Container inspect panel exposes parsed summary rows while retaining raw output.
Backend and frontend validation commands pass for the changed slice.
assumptions: Unknown network names without explicit static addresses remain allowed for pre-stage workflows.
Playwright browser smoke remains out-of-gate due host dependency and is intentionally excluded this cycle.

tasks.notes: Added container network overlap validation and static attachment address/prefix safety checks for upsert/install and network upsert flows.
Added image quick actions from catalog rows, inspect parsed-summary view, and client-side overlap pre-check before network save.
Added tests for overlap rejection, invalid static address rejection, and valid static address acceptance.
Manual review pass pending before next backlog tranche.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_containers_automation_v1.py && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s smoke:runtime
